header.details: Web Developer | Ruby on Rails & JavaScript

intro.summary: I'm a web developer transitioning into software engineering after nearly 10 years in education and staff training in Japan and Taiwan. In my previous career, I trained and onboarded 50+ staff, led teams across multiple schools, and designed and implemented a new training system. That experience taught me to approach problems systematically, communicate clearly, and keep improving the way I work — skills I now bring to software development.
intro.experience: Alongside my studies, I'm building bilingual websites for local businesses, working directly with clients to turn their requirements into responsive, practical websites for their customers.
intro.study: I'm nearing completion ofThe Odin Project'sFull Stack Ruby on Rails curriculum, with projects spanning Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, testing, deployment, and responsive frontend development.
intro.hobbies: Outside of coding, I enjoy hiking, snowboarding, barbecuing with friends, and working on a small backyard garden I started this year.
